source.regression: The sweep only checked `typeof data[k] === 'string'`, so '12/03/2026' matched. `new Date('12/03/2026')` is 3 December, and that survives both the isNaN check and `getFullYear() < 2000` in buildCollectionsFromFeed -- a real, wrong food collection shipping to users. The sweep now also requires an ISO-shaped value. (The pre-existing 'feed-food-not-in-rollout' case only covers a string sentinel on a KNOWN key, and 'foodNextDateCount: 3' is a number, so neither exercised this path.)
